description: This is the entry point for a React.js frontend application. It imports React and ReactDOM libraries, along with CSS styles and the main App component. It creates a root element in the DOM and renders the App component within React.StrictMode for development checks.

methods.name: createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root container for rendering React components.

methods.name: render
